plugins.name: image-to-ansi
plugins.description: Convert an image into a terminal-renderable string of ANSI colour codes and block/ASCII characters — CLI splash screens, TUI banners, neofetch-style logos, README art.

plugins.name: voice
plugins.description: Lets agents write and speak as you. /voice:init builds your VOICE.md once from your pre-AI writing and a short interview; /voice:write (default) and /voice:speak produce output in your voice; /voice:update tunes it anytime.
